back_translation: Woe to you who are at ease in Zion and who feel secure on Mount Samaria, the notable leaders of the foremost nation, to whom the house of Israel comes!
Cross over to Calneh and look; from there go to Hamath the great, then go down to Gath of the Philistines. Are you better than these kingdoms? Is their territory larger than yours?
You who put off the day of disaster, yet bring near the seat of violence;
you who lie on beds of ivory and sprawl on your couches, eating lambs from the flock and calves from the fattening stall;
you who strum idly on the harp and, like David, invent musical instruments for yourselves;
you who drink wine from bowls and anoint yourselves with the finest oils, but are not grieved over the ruin of Joseph.
Therefore they will now be the first to go into exile, and the revelry of those who lounge about will come to an end.
The Lord GOD has sworn by Himself—the LORD God of Hosts declares: I abhor the pride of Jacob and hate his citadels; I will hand over the city and all that is in it.
And it will be that if ten men remain in one house, they too will die.

When a relative who is to burn the bodies comes to carry the bones out of the house, and asks the one deep inside the house, 'Is anyone else with you?' and he answers, 'No,' then he will say, 'Hush! For we must not invoke the name of the LORD.'
For behold, the LORD commands, and the great house will be smashed to fragments and the small house to pieces.
Do horses run on a cliff of rock? Does one plow there with oxen? Yet you have turned justice into poison and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood—
you who rejoice over the capture of Lo-debar, who say, 'Have we not taken Karnaim for ourselves by our own strength?'
Behold, O house of Israel, I will raise up a nation against you, declares the LORD God of Hosts, and they will oppress you from the entrance of Hamath to the Brook of the Arabah.
